notes.eligible: Replace with the official register size published by the CEC (בעלי זכות בחירה) before 25.10. 7,340,000 is an approximate pre-election figure; reports range up to ~7.56M.
notes.results_url: Same path as 2019–2022 (media2X.bechirot.gov.il/files/expb.csv). On 9.10.2026 it answered 404 to GitHub's runners while a third party saw a placeholder file from other networks (5.10): the files may not be up yet, or GitHub's cloud addresses may be blocked. Nothing is fetched from it before 27.10 22:00 Israel time; until then it is only probed (status.results_probe).
notes.drill_url: The 2022 file used by a rehearsal (falls back to data/official/k25_expb.csv).
notes.station_turnout_url: Set to the CEC per-station turnout file once its address is known. Status: chair's decision of 16.8.2026 (at least four publications per regular polling station); the High Court (בג״ץ 60697-08-26, 17.9.2026) vacated the plenum's 6.9 decision and left the ban on identified reporting; per Walla, JNS and Channel 12 (every four hours) the aggregate per-station publication stands. As of 9.10 no times, URL or format were published.
notes.github_feed: Set to false to stop the GitHub Actions loop (it re-reads this file every pass) so a laptop or self-hosted run can take over without touching repository settings.
notes.lean_during_voting: The 2022-vote-weighted turnout pace by bloc is published during voting hours only when true (pending the CEC legal adviser); after 22:00 always.
notes.projection_paused: Set to true to stop showing the projection (the count is still shown), e.g. if the CEC file looks inconsistent; pause_reason is shown on the page.
notes.envelopes_expected: Valid votes expected in double envelopes. Set ONLY from an official CEC statement (acting DG Dean Livne reportedly expects 600–700k envelopes; 2022 had 462,807 voters, 458,714 valid); otherwise it is estimated from 2022 and the count is never marked complete.
